<?php
use Fiber as F;
$name = 'gEtCURRENT';
$class = 'Fiber';
$a = F::$name(...);
$name = 'missing';
$b = $class::getCurrent(...);
echo (int)($a == $b), '|', (int)($a !== $b), '|', get_class($a), '|';
$weak = WeakReference::create($a);
$fiber = new Fiber(static function () use ($a) {
    echo (int)($a(...[]) === Fiber::getCurrent()), '|';
    $suspend = F::suspend(...);
    echo $suspend(...['value' => 'W']), '|';
    return 11;
});
unset($a);
echo $fiber->start(), '|';
$fiber->resume('R');
echo $fiber->getReturn(), '|', (int)($weak->get() === null);

<?php
$current = \Fiber::gEtCurrent(...);
$alias = $current->__invoke(...);
$copy = clone $current;
echo (int)($alias === $current), '|', (int)($copy !== $current), '|', (int)($copy() === null), '|';
$fiber = new Fiber(static function () use ($current) {
    echo (int)($current() === Fiber::getCurrent()), '|';
    return 17;
});
$fiber->start();
echo $fiber->getReturn();

<?php
$input = new Fiber(static function () { return 7; });
$weak = WeakReference::create($input);
$name = 'gEtCuRrEnT';
$current = $input->$name(...);
$name = 'missing';
$suspend = $input->suspend(...);
unset($input);
echo (int)($weak->get() === null), '|', (int)($current() === null), '|';
$fiber = new Fiber(static function () use ($suspend) {
    echo $suspend(value: 'W'), '|';
    return 23;
});
echo $fiber->start(), '|';
$fiber->resume('R');
echo $fiber->getReturn();

<?php
$weak = null;
function temporarySuspend331() {
    global $weak;
    $capture = Fiber::suspend(...);
    $weak = WeakReference::create($capture);
    return $capture;
}
class DirectArgument331 {
    public function __destruct() {
        global $weak;
        echo 'D', (int)($weak->get() !== null), '|';
    }
}
$fiber = new Fiber(static function () {
    echo 'E|';
    echo temporarySuspend331()(new DirectArgument331), '|';
    return 7;
});
$sent = $fiber->start();
echo (int)($weak->get() !== null), '|';
unset($sent);
echo 'K|';
$fiber->resume('R');
echo (int)($weak->get() === null), '|', $fiber->getReturn();

<?php
$weak = null;
class InvokeArgument331 {
    public function __destruct() {
        global $weak;
        echo 'D', (int)($weak->get() !== null), '|';
    }
}
$fiber = new Fiber(static function () {
    global $weak;
    $capture = Fiber::suspend(...);
    $weak = WeakReference::create($capture);
    $alias = $capture->__invoke(...);
    unset($capture);
    try { $alias->__invoke(value: new InvokeArgument331); }
    catch (RuntimeException $error) { echo 'T', $error->getMessage(), '|'; }
    unset($alias);
    return 19;
});
$sent = $fiber->start();
unset($sent);
echo 'K|';
$fiber->throw(new RuntimeException('X'));
echo (int)($weak->get() === null), '|', $fiber->getReturn();

<?php
$current = Fiber::getCurrent(...);
$suspend = Fiber::suspend(...);
try { $current(1); } catch (ArgumentCountError $error) { echo 'A|'; }
try { $current->__invoke(nope: 1); } catch (Error $error) { echo 'N|'; }
try { $suspend(1, 2); } catch (ArgumentCountError $error) { echo 'B|'; }
try { $suspend->__invoke(nope: 1); } catch (Error $error) { echo 'M|'; }
try { $suspend(); } catch (FiberError $error) { echo 'F'; }

<?php
$capture = Fiber::getCurrent(...);
$weak = WeakReference::create($capture);
$fiber = new Fiber($capture);
unset($capture);
echo (int)($weak->get() !== null), '|';
$fiber->start();
echo (int)($fiber->getReturn() === $fiber), '|', (int)($weak->get() === null);

$weak = null;
class RootResumeArgument331 {
    public function __destruct() {

    }
}
$capture = Fiber::suspend(...);
$weak = WeakReference::create($capture);

$sent = $fiber->start(value: new RootResumeArgument331);
echo (int)($weak->get() !== null), '|';
unset($sent);
echo 'K|';
$fiber->resume(29);
echo (int)($weak->get() === null), '|', $fiber->getReturn();

<?php
$weak = null;
class RootThrowArgument331 {
    public function __destruct() {
        global $weak;
        echo 'D', (int)($weak->get() !== null), '|';
    }
}
$capture = Fiber::suspend(...);
$weak = WeakReference::create($capture);
$fiber = new Fiber($capture);
unset($capture);
$sent = $fiber->start(new RootThrowArgument331);
unset($sent);
echo 'K|';
try { $fiber->throw(new RuntimeException('X')); }
catch (RuntimeException $error) { echo 'T', $error->getMessage(), '|'; }
echo (int)($weak->get() === null), '|', (int)$fiber->isTerminated();
